info.title: noobly Wiki Platform API
info.description: Unified REST API for the noobly Wiki Platform (port 9101). Covers the Datasources module (`/api/*`), Wiki module (`/applications/wiki/api/*`) and Blueprint module (`/applications/blueprint/api/*`).

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token (24 hr). Obtain from POST /api/auth/token or the API tokens section of your profile.

get.description: Answered with Cache-Control: no-store — clientCacheVersion is the stamp each browser compares against its own to decide whether to drop its cached navigation trees, so a cached response would suppress the purge.

clientCacheVersion.description: Client cache epoch. When it differs from the value a browser recorded, that browser drops its cached navigation trees on load.

get.summary: Read the client cache epoch (admin screen)

200.description: Current epoch and whether the caller may bump it

post.summary: Bump the client cache epoch (admin only)
post.description: Makes every browser drop its cached navigation trees on its next page load. Sign-ins, layouts, view preferences, chat history and dismissed announcements are untouched.

get.description: Returns a mix of document suggestions ({title, path, spaceName, type}, where path is space-relative) and bare index terms. Pass documents=true for document suggestions only — every item then carries a resolvable path, and the folder path is matched as well as the file name.

parameters.name: documents
parameters.description: Path-bearing document suggestions only — no bare index terms.

parameters.name: fileTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated indexer types to keep, e.g. 'markdown'.
